title: Governed World Models and Reality Grounding
subtitle: A world model should be governed as a fallible, versioned prediction service whose state… imagined consequences may influence planning and action; observation must repeatedly reconcile imagination with reality.

display.problem: Planning and control fail when an agent's latent or simulated… hidden, or when model updates expand action authority without evidence.
display.insufficient: A more accurate predictor, larger simulator, or compelling rollout is… reward exploitation, and unsafe actions selected from attractive hallucinated futures.

mechanism.label: World-model outputs versioned
mechanism.detail: Represent world-model outputs as versioned state-transition hypotheses with provenance, horizon, uncertainty, and validity domains.

mechanism.label: Separate observation encoding
mechanism.detail: Separate observation encoding, latent dynamics, decoding, value/reward… use so each can be challenged independently.

mechanism.label: Calibrate uncertainty horizon state
mechanism.detail: Calibrate uncertainty by horizon, state region, intervention type, and consequence class.

mechanism.label: Receding-horizon observation
mechanism.detail: Use receding-horizon observation updates and explicit residuals to reconcile predicted and observed state.

proof_targets: In the finite admission model, an unsupported… uncalibrated rollout cannot authorize a consequential action.
A material observation residual forces bounded re-estimation… safe hold before further model-based execution.
Observation can override imagination and trigger replanning.
